[P1] 传统童谣
连环画出版社
小老鼠

[P2] 小老鼠
金波／编选
胡永凯／图
连环画出版社

[P3] 排排坐
排排坐，
吃果果，
你一个，
我一个，
弟弟睡着了，
给他留一个。

[P4] 杨柳
杨柳青，
放风筝；
杨柳黄，
踢毽忙。

[P5] 小老鼠
小老鼠，
上灯台；
偷油吃，
下不来，
吱吱吱，
叫奶奶；
奶奶不肯来，
叽里咕噜滚下来。

[P6] 红花开得万万年
紫金花，开得鲜，
开了紫金开鸡冠。
鸡冠花，开得红，
开了鸡冠开芙蓉。
芙蓉花，靠南墙，
开了芙蓉开丁香。
丁香花，颤悠悠，
开了丁香开佛手。
佛手花，五指垂，
开了佛手开玫瑰。
玫瑰花，红油油，
开了玫瑰开石榴。
石榴花，红艳艳，
开了石榴开牡丹。
牡丹花，人爱见，
红花开得万万年。

[P7] 墙上一个鼓
墙上一个鼓，
鼓上画老虎。
老虎扯破了鼓，
拿块布来补鼓，
到底布补鼓，
还是布补虎。

[P8] 小青蛙
呱呱呱，呱呱呱，
我是骄傲的小青蛙。
白肚皮，大嘴巴，
两只眼睛圆鼓鼓，
背上画着绿花花，
你要问我是哪一个，
我就是那——
骄傲的小青蛙，
呱呱呱，呱呱呱。

[P9] 大年初一扭一扭
小孩儿，你别馋，
过了腊八就是年；
腊八粥，喝几天，
哩哩拉拉二十三。
二十三，糖瓜粘，
二十四，扫房子，
二十五，糊窗户，
二十六，炖炖肉，
二十七，宰公鸡，
二十八，把面发，
二十九，蒸馒头，
三十晚上熬一宿，
大年初一扭一扭。

[P10] 高高山上一头牛
高高山上一头牛，
两个犄角一个头，
四个蹄子分八瓣，
尾巴长在身后头。

[P11] 月亮奶奶
月亮奶奶，
要吃韭菜；
韭菜好辣，
要吃黄瓜；
黄瓜青青，
要吃油饼；
油饼喷香，
要吃面汤；
面汤稀烂，
要吃鸡蛋；
鸡蛋腥气，
要吃公鸡；
公鸡有毛，
要吃樱桃；
樱桃太酸，
吃个栗子面丹丹。

[P12] 腿
小黑鸡，两条腿，
大黄牛，四条腿，
蜻蜓六条腿，
螃蟹八条腿，
蚂蚁十条腿，
蚯蚓、鳝鱼没有腿。

[P13] 打箩儿筛
打箩儿筛，
曳箩儿筛，
麦子熟了请你伯；
你伯爱吃肉儿，
你叔爱吃豆儿。

[P14] 下雨哩
下雨哩，
冒泡哩，
小妮儿，
戴着草帽哩。
草帽尖，
顶着天；
天打雷，
轰隆轰隆又一回。

[P15] 摇摇摇
摇摇摇，摇到外婆桥，
外婆买条鱼烧烧，
头不熟尾巴焦，
盛到碗里必剥跳。
白米饭，鱼汤浇，
吃完了宝宝又来摇。
摇摇摇，摇到外婆桥，
外婆叫我好宝宝，
糖一包，果一包，
又有团子又有糕。

[P16] 十二月花
正月百花云里开，
二月杏花送春来，
三月桃花红似火，
四月芦花就地开，
五月栀子心里黄，
六月荷花满池塘，
七月菱花铺水面，
八月桂花满村香，
九月菊花黄似锦，
十月芙蓉赛牡丹，
十一月无花无人采，
十二月梅花斗雪开。

[P17] 五指歌
一二三四五，
上山打老虎，
老虎没打到，
打到小松鼠。
松鼠有几只？
让我数一数，
数来又数去，
一二三四五。

[P18] 小老鼠

full_text_en:
[P1] Traditional Children's Rhymes
Lianhuanhua Publishing House
Little Mouse

[P2] Little Mouse
Jin Bo / Editor and Compiler
Hu Yongkai / Illustrations
Lianhuanhua Publishing House

[P3] Sit in a row
Sit in a row,
Eat fruits,
One for you,
One for me,
The younger brother is asleep,
Leave one for him.

[P4] Willow
Willow green, flying kites;
Willow yellow, playing shuttlecock.

[P5] Little Mouse
Little mouse,
Climbs the lampstand;
Steals oil to eat,
Can't come down,
Squeak squeak squeak,
Calls grandma;
Grandma won't come,
Tumbles down with a jumble.

[P6] Red flowers bloom for ten thousand years
Purple gold flowers, blooming fresh,
After purple gold, chicken crown blooms.
Chicken crown flowers, blooming red,
After chicken crown, hibiscus blooms.
Hibiscus flowers, by the southern wall,
After hibiscus, lilac blooms.
Lilac flowers, trembling gently,
After lilac, Buddha's hand blooms.
Buddha's hand flowers, fingers hanging down,
After Buddha's hand, roses bloom.
Rose flowers, red and shiny,
After roses, pomegranate blooms.
Pomegranate flowers, bright red,
After pomegranate, peony blooms.
Peony flowers, beloved by people,
Red flowers bloom for ten thousand years.

[P7] A Drum on the Wall
A drum on the wall,
A tiger painted on the drum.
The tiger tears the drum,
Take a piece of cloth to mend the drum,
In the end, cloth mends the drum,
But it's still cloth mending the tiger.

[P8] Little Frog
Croak, croak, croak, croak, croak,
I am the proud little frog.
White belly, big mouth,
Two round eyes,
Green flowers painted on my back,
If you ask which one I am,
I am the——
Proud little frog,
Croak, croak, croak, croak, croak.

[P9] New Year's Day, twist and turn
Child, don't be greedy,
After Laba comes the New Year;
Laba porridge, drink for a few days,
Lili la la the 23rd.
On the 23rd, sticky candy;
On the 24th, clean the house;
On the 25th, paste the windows;
On the 26th, stew the meat;
On the 27th, slaughter the rooster;
On the 28th, ferment the dough;
On the 29th, steam the buns;
On the 30th, stay up all night;
New Year's Day, twist and turn.

[P10] High on the mountain, a cow
High on the mountain, a cow,
Two horns, one head,
Four hooves split into eight parts,
Tail grows behind the head.

[P11] Grandma Moon
Grandma Moon,
Wants to eat chives;
Chives are spicy,
Wants to eat cucumber;
Cucumber is green,
Wants to eat fried dough;
Fried dough is fragrant,
Wants to eat noodle soup;
Noodle soup is thin and soft,
Wants to eat eggs;
Eggs are fishy,
Wants to eat rooster;
Rooster has feathers,
Wants to eat cherries;
Cherries are too sour,
Eat a chestnut flour dan dan.

[P12] Legs
Little black chicken, two legs,
Big yellow cow, four legs,
Dragonfly, six legs,
Crab, eight legs,
Ant, ten legs,
Earthworm, eel, no legs.

[P13] Sifting the Grain
Sifting the grain,
Sifting the grain,
When the wheat is ripe, invite your uncle;
Your uncle loves meat,
Your cousin loves beans.

[P14] It's raining
It's raining,
Bubbles rising,
Little girl,
Wearing a straw hat.
Straw hat pointy,
Touching the sky;
Sky thundering,
Boom boom again.

[P15] Rock-a-bye
Rock-a-bye, rock to Grandma's bridge,
Grandma buys a fish to cook,
Head not cooked, tail burnt,
Served in a bowl, it jumps.
White rice, fish soup poured,
After eating, baby comes to rock again.
Rock-a-bye, rock to Grandma's bridge,
Grandma calls me a good baby,
A pack of candy, a pack of fruit,
Also dumplings and cakes.

[P16] Twelve Months of Flowers
In the first month, all flowers bloom in the clouds,
In the second month, apricot blossoms bring spring,
In the third month, peach blossoms are red as fire,
In the fourth month, reed flowers spread on the ground,
In the fifth month, gardenia blooms with yellow hearts,
In the sixth month, lotus flowers fill the pond,
In the seventh month, water caltrops spread across the water surface,
In the eighth month, osmanthus fills the village with fragrance,
In the ninth month, chrysanthemums are yellow like brocade,
In the tenth month, hibiscus rivals peonies,
In the eleventh month, no flowers, no one to pick,
In the twelfth month, plum blossoms fight the snow to bloom.

[P17] Five-Finger Song
One, two, three, four, five,
Go up the mountain to fight the tiger,
Didn't fight the tiger,
Fought a little squirrel.
How many squirrels are there?
Let me count them,
Counting back and forth,
One, two, three, four, five.

[P18] Little Mouse

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，左侧竖排粉色大字为“传统童谣”，右侧插图描绘了两只风格化的老鼠，下方横排白色大字为“小老鼠”，右下角有“连环画出版社”字样。
[P2] 本页为绘本的扉页，显示书名《小老鼠》，编选者为金波，插图作者为胡永凯，出版社为连环画出版社。左侧有一只色彩鲜艳的卡通老鼠插图。
[P3] 本页展示了一首名为《排排坐》的童谣，画面中三个孩子坐在长凳上吃果子，旁边一个弟弟在睡觉，一只猫在树上观望，背景是结满果实的树。
[P4] 本页展示了一首名为《杨柳》的童谣，画面中两个孩子在柳树下玩耍，一个放风筝，一个踢毽子，背景有垂柳和一只鸟形风筝。
[P5] 本页展示了一首名为《小老鼠》的童谣，画面描绘了一只小老鼠爬上灯台偷油吃，因下不来而叫奶奶，奶奶不肯来，最终从灯台上滚下来的情景。
[P6] 本页展示了一首名为《红花开得万万年》的童谣，画面中两个穿着传统服饰的儿童在花盆两侧跳舞，花盆中盛开着多种色彩鲜艳的花朵，背景为绿色。
[P7] 本页展示了一首名为《墙上一个鼓》的童谣，画面描绘了一个黄色的鼓，鼓面上画着一只色彩鲜艳的老虎，鼓旁散落着布料、剪刀和针线，表现了用布修补被老虎扯破的鼓的情景。
[P8] 本页展示了一首名为《小青蛙》的童谣，画面中一只色彩鲜艳、带有花纹的小青蛙在蓝色背景中跳跃，周围点缀着几朵风格化的花朵。
[P9] 本页展示了一首名为《大年初一扭一扭》的童谣，描绘了从腊八到大年初一的春节准备习俗，画面左侧是孩子们舞狮、放鞭炮的热闹场景，右侧是家庭内贴窗花、炖肉、准备年货的温馨画面。
[P10] 本页展示了一首名为《高高山上一头牛》的童谣，画面描绘了一头色彩斑斓的牛站在山丘上，背景中有一个小孩坐在云朵上吹笛子，整体风格充满童趣和想象力。
[P11] 本页展示了一首名为《月亮奶奶》的童谣，画面中一个拟人化的月亮形象周围环绕着韭菜、黄瓜、油饼、面汤、鸡蛋、公鸡、樱桃和栗子面丹丹等食物，表现了童谣中月亮奶奶想吃各种食物的趣味情节。
[P12] 本页展示了一首名为《腿》的童谣，通过列举不同动物的腿的数量，帮助儿童认知动物特征。画面以红色为背景，描绘了小黑鸡、大黄牛、蜻蜓、螃蟹、蚂蚁、蚯蚓、鳝鱼和一个小孩等形象，色彩鲜艳，风格质朴。
[P13] 本页展示了一首名为《打箩儿筛》的童谣，画面描绘了一位戴着斗笠的成年人正在用筛子筛谷物，旁边有一个小孩在观看，背景中有装满谷物的袋子，整体风格质朴生动。
[P14] 本页展示了一首名为《下雨哩》的童谣，画面描绘了一个小女孩在雨中用草帽遮雨的场景，背景是乌云和雨滴，地面有水洼，整体风格生动有趣。
[P15] 本页展示了一首名为《摇摇摇》的童谣，画面描绘了一个孩子在摇篮中被摇晃，外婆为他准备鱼汤饭并给予糖果、果子、团子和糕点，表现了温馨的祖孙亲情和童谣的趣味性。
[P16] 本页展示了一首名为《十二月花》的童谣，通过列举一年中各个月份盛开的代表性花卉，帮助儿童认识季节与植物的对应关系。画面描绘了多个花瓶中插着不同种类的花，色彩丰富，风格质朴。
[P17] 本页展示了一首名为《五指歌》的童谣，通过数数游戏帮助儿童学习数字1到5。画面以红色为背景，描绘了一个戴着黄色头巾的小孩手持彩色玩具，周围环绕着多只色彩斑斓的黑色小猫，整体风格活泼生动。
[P18] 本页展示了一本儿童绘本的目录页，标题为《小老鼠》，列出了包括《排排坐》《杨柳》《小老鼠》《红花开得万万年》等在内的多首童谣名称。
